system_overview: A generalized version of the Die Hard water jug puzzle that supports an arbitrary number of jugs, each with a specified positive integer capacity, and an arbitrary goal quantity of water to measure. The model checker finds a solution by searching for a state where any jug contains the goal amount, treating this as an invariant violation to produce a counterexample trace.
actors_and_components: A configurable set of jugs, each with a specified positive integer capacity
A water faucet that provides unlimited water for filling any jug
state_variables: A mapping from each jug to its current water level, represented as a non-negative integer
initial_state: All jugs start completely empty (each containing 0 units of water).
actions: Fill a jug: sets a chosen jug to its full capacity while all other jugs remain unchanged.
Empty a jug: dumps a chosen jug to 0 while all other jugs remain unchanged.

Pour from one jug to another: transfers water from a source jug to a destination jug. The amount poured is the lesser of (a) the water in the source jug and (b) the remaining capacity of the destination jug. The source jug loses the poured amount, and the destination jug gains it.
safety_properties: Type correctness: the water level in each jug is always a non-negative integer.

Not-solved invariant: no jug ever contains exactly the goal amount of water. This is intentionally expected to be violated; the counterexample trace produced by the model checker is the solution to the puzzle.
model_bounds: The state space depends on the number of jugs and their capacities. Each jug can hold values from 0 to its capacity, so the total state space is the product of (capacity + 1) for each jug.
additional_assumptions: Each jug capacity must be a positive integer, and the goal must be a non-negative integer. The jugs are not calibrated, so only completely filling, completely emptying, or pouring between jugs (until one is full or the other is empty) are valid actions. The specification requires a separate model-checking module to supply concrete values for the jug set, capacities, and goal.
